defect: An earlier property-load completion can overwrite a newer displayed status. ObjectEditorPageControl.runService schedules loads without serializing their completions.

red.observed: Newer completion applies Normal; older completion subsequently calls loadEditorValues with Invalid; never-invoked assertion fails
red.method: Controlled callbacks captured from the actual production loading path; not a timed GUI stress run

fix: Record request ownership by property ID on the UI thread. Completion filters properties superseded by newer loads, while retaining unrelated fields from an earlier full load. Ignore null results from failed loads and retain existing disposed/editability checks.

green.cleanup: Temporary centralized fixture and roles removed; original HBA restored

newAssertions: Older read-only status response cannot overwrite a newer status
Newer read-only load does not discard unrelated fields from an earlier full load
Null load completion does not apply values
limits: The controlled callback tests are not scheduler-pressure or customer desktop-cloud tests
No database object validity is changed by this display-only bug
